name: mangalibrary
description: A Java-free, TypeScript media server for comics and manga (Komga-compatible REST API).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix importer install
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix server run type-check && npm --prefix importer run type-check
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix importer test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix importer run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix server run lint:fix && npm --prefix importer run lint:fix
